scope: Selected Nano first installation from a verified non-Firmingo blink baseline through the iPhone in-app boot-drive picker

host.connection: Nano connected directly to unlocked iPhone; Mac deployment/report collection over Wi-Fi

board.hardwareAuthorization: D2 and REC disconnected during transfer and normal boot

baseline.normalModeBehavior: D13 on 500 ms / off 500 ms; no Firmingo or network service
baseline.compileCommand: arduino-cli --config-file arduino-cli.local.yaml compile --fqbn rp2040:rp2040:arduino_nano_connect:usbstack=picosdk,flash=16777216_0,freq=125,ipbtstack=ipv4only,opt=Small,rtti=Disabled,exceptions=Disabled --warnings all --build-path build/mobile-rom-iphone/blink-build --output-dir build/mobile-rom-iphone/blink-output build/mobile-rom-iphone/non_firmingo_blink
baseline.purposeLimit: Hardware-test starting condition only; no SDK restoration feature

firmingoImage.layout: Whole erase-sector UF2 groups; six erased resident-tail padding pages

observations.initialPickerNavigation: Operator initially could not switch volumes. Upper-left back navigation to Browse/Locations exposed RPI-RP2.

evidence.originals: Ignored local build directories in Firmingo and FirmingoKit

remaining: First installation from non-Firmingo firmware on iPad
Physically interrupted mobile transfer and new explicit recovery on each claimed host
Offline multi-file compilation and managed upload after the mobile setup workflow
First-use permission UX, broader board/OS/cable matrix and release distribution
limits: One selected Nano and iPhone host; no throughput or cold-attachment matrix
Functional post-install verification; no final flash readback from the iPhone
Boot-drive markers are generic RP2040 metadata; physical Nano selection is user-confirmed
No new CI execution or fresh firmware build matrix
